Chapter 791: Chapter 11: The Majesty of God (Please Subscribe)_3

“`

“Cut it off for me.”

The giant eyeball ‘Magic Eye’ didn’t hesitate to abandon the part of its body that was within the Tianqing World.

Its consciousness completely shifted to the remaining body outside the world, and then it frantically fled into the distance.

To give up half its body was a severe cost, and it was unknown how long it would take to recover.

But according to the precedent set by the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’, if the ‘Magic Eye’ didn’t do this, it estimated its entire body would be left behind.

...

Escaping with half its body was much better than being annihilated.

From start to finish, the giant eyeball ‘Magic Eye’ had no thoughts of resisting or fighting back desperately.

There was no point at all—didn’t the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ resist?

…

Outside the Tianqing World.

Deep within the Boundless Void.

A number of Foreign Evil Gods were observing the situation in the Tianqing World with an attitude of watching a drama unfold.

However, when they saw the huge body of the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ rapidly disintegrate into the most Origin Source of energy, completely swallowed by the Tianqing World, and then its presence nearly vanished, they immediately widened their eyes.

What happened?

What’s the situation with the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’?

Has it fallen?

Or has it been suppressed?

The numerous Foreign Evil Gods indeed enjoyed seeing changes occur in the Tianqing World.

But they never expected such changes to be so fierce, so exaggerated?

In the eyes of the Foreign Evil Gods, so-called changes were merely some obstacles that made the ‘Magic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ suffer, requiring them to pay a greater price to conquer the Tianqing World.

As for being counter-killed or counter-suppressed.

No Evil God dared to entertain such thoughts.

Because the probability was too low.

The ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ and ‘Magic Eye’, these two Foreign Evil Gods wielding the trump cards given by the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master, who could counter-kill them, who could suppress them?

“Magic Eye?”

The annihilation of the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ startled the Evil Gods, and they quickly turned their gaze toward the ‘Magic Eye’ not far away.

Under the watchful eyes of all the Foreign Evil Gods.

The ‘Magic Eye’, with half of its body trapped inside the world, did not hesitate to abandon the trapped half, as the remaining giant eye, like a dog that had lost its home, frantically fled from the Tianqing World.

Before the numerous Foreign Evil Gods could react.

Inside the Tianqing World.

A colossal hand suddenly reached out.

The hand, millions upon millions of miles large, easily captured the frantically fleeing ‘half eyeball’ and swiftly pulled it back into the Tianqing World.

Whoosh, whoosh, whoosh.

It took but a few breaths’ time.

On the world barrier of the Tianqing World, the two huge cracks rapidly healed and finally disappeared from sight.

…

Silence.

All the observing Foreign Evil Gods fell silent.

“`

“`

They had never imagined that such a reversal would occur.

Within the Tianqing World, a mysterious existence had suppressed both the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’ and ‘Demonic Eye’, two Foreign Evil Gods bestowed with bottom-line measures from the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master.

Especially the last scene they had witnessed, where the ‘Demonic Eye’, having abandoned half its body and thinking it had escaped certain death, hadn’t had the chance to breathe a sigh of relief before it was harshly snatched back by that grand hand that filled the sky.

“What in the world… What in the world happened?”

“What existence could there possibly be within that world?”

Each of the Foreign Evil Gods trembled in their hearts as they looked towards the Tianqing World, a chilling terror suddenly arising within them.

In the eyes of such Foreign Evil Gods, any world was a delicacy, a source of sustenance, but at this moment, the Tianqing World was making every one of them’s scalp tingle, wishing they could flee from it immediately.

…

“The trouble has been resolved.”

Lin Yuan casually suppressed ‘Demonic Eye’ and took it in, then once again observed the Tianqing World to see if there were any ‘fish that slipped the net.’

After checking several times,

Lin Yuan then turned and returned to the Canopy Continent, before the Martial Hall.

“I’ve seen the Martial Ancestor….”

High Priest Qingyao immediately greeted Lin Yuan with an utmost respectful bow.

Positioned at the highest point in the Tianqing World, High Priest Qingyao had seen everything with crystal clarity, two infinitely fierce Foreign Evil Gods, before Lin Yuan, were like two chickens awaiting slaughter, incapable of even a hint of resistance, easily suppressed.

This scene greatly shocked High Priest Qingyao, and it was only at this moment that she realized the true extent of the existence of the Martial Ancestor that the countless beings of the Tianqing World had worshipped day and night for hundreds of thousands of years.

“I am going to seclude myself, do not disturb me unless there’s something important.”

Lin Yuan spoke briefly and then walked directly into the Martial Hall.

The doors of the Martial Hall slowly closed behind him.

“Martial Ancestor…”

High Priest Qingyao’s voice trembled, and then she turned around, looked down at the countless Martial Dao Cultivators and all beings, and murmured to herself, “We have survived…”

…

Inside the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged.

In front of him floated two misty forms, the life cores of the ‘Demonic Eye’ and ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream.’

“These two Evil Gods…”

Lin Yuan’s Spirit Will was incredibly strong, easily completely refining the two life cores and becoming intimately familiar with all their memories.

Whether it was the ‘Demonic Eye’ or the ‘Myriad Tentacle Stream’, most of their memories were of a state of madness, roaming the Boundless Void, fighting and devouring other Foreign Evil Gods, discovering worlds and then attempting to invade and devour them.

Until they met the Black Demon Pavilion’s Master and realizing they were utterly powerless to resist, they chose to submit.

“Their power is somewhat interesting.”

Lin Yuan studied with care.

Moments later,

Lin Yuan seemed thoughtful as he took up the misty forms again.

“Speaking of which, although this physical body is Innate strong, deeply rooted, and extraordinarily fitting for Martial Tao, has it not embarked upon the Martial Path Evolutionary Path?”

Lin Yuan pondered silently.

It was like a naturally strong person who hadn’t learned any martial techniques.

“By cultivating the Martial Dao Cultivation Evolution Path with this physique, it will certainly be able to discover deeper potential in the physical body, and moreover, give birth to a fifth Physical Body Divine Ability?”

Lin Yuan’s eyes shone bright.
